verdict.rationale: Turso documents a Platform API reference for programmatically managing databases, groups, organizations and tokens, including per-agent database create, token-scope and teardown flows. Token scoping is documented, and an HTTP/fetch-based client gives programmatic data access. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
